people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

translations.web: Now Yahweh said to Abram, “Leave your country, and your relatives, and your father’s house, and go to the land that I will show you.
translations.bsb: Then the LORD said to Abram, “Leave your country, your kindred, and your father’s household, and go to the land I will show you.
